alternatives.title: 1 · Three destinations
alternatives.hypothesis: My Organ, Contacts and Connect stay stable. Each opens a short directory of named pages. Predictable location; more secondary links than the task hub.

scenarios: Open the Castle: understand my Organ and reach Ana without reading a tool inventory.
Share my contact pairing code, then scan a contact code: scanning fills the field without saving.
Find a nearby Organ; compare its fingerprint before adding or chatting.
Select Ana; change trust, incoming/outgoing limits and delivery independently; find workspaces and login access.
Inspect devices; distinguish signed Karma permission from local execution; issue a private enrolment code.
Find root-key export/detach and encrypted owner backup without showing secrets on the opening page.
Check mail carrier acceptance separately from recipient receipt; recover saved mail and manage pickup points.
Find public posts, profile, private requests, saved searches, consent and service administration without deleting these capabilities.
Compare fresh, pending, offline/retry, viewing-only, expired and large-list states in every alternative.
Use keyboard navigation and touch at desktop, mobile and Sand widths; check form focus and confirmation cancellation.
